I told Hollis in a #central-team thread reply that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats.

That number comes from Tobias's post in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing newer about it has been posted there since. Hollis is in that channel, and a seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to share there.

I couldn't check it against a contract or account file, because no Marrow files show up in the shared folders. I said so in the reply.
